『Born This Way』was already being sung before Lady Gaga was born

Lady Gaga's 2011『Born This Way』has a clear prehistory that predates Gaga herself. 1975年の原曲、1977年のCarl Bean版、2011年のglobal hitをたどりながら、why「born this way」became such a powerful argument for self-acceptance—and why science and social experience make the phrase more complicated than it sounds.
